811.body:
"Extreme Green" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $5,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Tomorrow's count on "Extreme Green" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
